# Polyglot Music

> Polyglot Music creates new-language versions of songs, sung in the original artist's own voice and in sync with the original performance. Every voice. Every language. Perfectly in sync.

## About

Polyglot Music works with artists, labels, publishers and managers to release music in languages it was never recorded in. The result is a dubbed version of the song, not a cover and not a stand-in: the artist's voice, phrasing and feeling carry into each new language. Artists and rights holders approve every version before it ships.

- Website: https://www.polyglotmusic.co
- Contact: info@polyglotmusic.co
